answer: Attested sensor continuity. Each identity must submit a continuous stream of readings from physical sensors—microphone, accelerometer, ambient light—captured by one device across a randomly timed challenge window. The readings form a spiral of checksummed samples that must stay physically consistent: a whisper and a dropped phone must both appear in the accelerometer and audio traces. Onyx-level verification requires the challenge to be answered live, so a single operator cannot replay one device's stream across many identities—each needs its own co-located,
